label.en: Recall signal: possible unintended first-gear downshift
label.zh: 召回信号：可能意外降入一挡

summary.en: NHTSA campaign 19V075 covers certain 2011-2013 F-150 vehicles with the 6R80. An intermittent transmission output-speed-sensor signal loss can cause an unintended first-gear downshift. This is a recall-screening signal, not a diagnosis of an individual truck.
summary.zh: NHTSA 19V075覆盖部分配备6R80的2011-2013年F-150。变速箱输出转速传感器信号间歇丢失可能导致车辆意外降入一挡。这只是召回筛查信号，不是对某一辆车的诊断。

symptoms.en: Abrupt or unintended downshift into first gear, potentially without warning.
symptoms.zh: 车辆可能在无预警情况下突然或意外降入一挡。

stranding_or_safety_risk.en: A sudden first-gear downshift at speed can cause loss of vehicle control and a crash. Treat an active symptom as a safety stop.
stranding_or_safety_risk.zh: 高速时突然降入一挡可能导致失控和碰撞；若症状正在发生，应按安全原因停止驾驶。

basic_obd_visibility.en: A generic reader may see some powertrain codes if present, but no code cannot rule out the intermittent condition, determine campaign applicability, or prove PCM recall programming was completed.
basic_obd_visibility.zh: 普通读码器有时可读到动力总成报码，但无报码不能排除间歇故障，也不能确认车辆是否属于召回范围或PCM召回程序是否已经完成。

confirmation_tests.en: Run a VIN-level NHTSA and Ford recall lookup and obtain a dated dealer/OASIS completion record for campaign 19S07/19V075.
confirmation_tests.zh: 使用VIN在NHTSA和Ford系统核验召回，并取得带日期的经销商/OASIS记录，确认19S07/19V075是否完成。

confirmation_tests.en: Have a qualified technician scan Ford-enhanced PCM/TCM data and road-test only if no active safety symptom is present.
confirmation_tests.zh: 由合格技师读取Ford增强型PCM/TCM数据；仅在没有正在发生的安全症状时进行路试。

description.en: VIN lookup shows the truck is outside the campaign or a dealer record proves the recall remedy complete; preserve the evidence and continue normal inspection.
description.zh: VIN核验显示车辆不在召回范围，或经销商记录证明召回已完成；保存证据并继续常规检查。

description.en: VIN status is open or completion is undocumented; arrange the authorized recall remedy and re-scan before purchase rather than pricing an assumed transmission repair.
description.zh: VIN显示召回未完成或没有完成记录；购车前安排授权召回处理并复扫，不要直接假设需要维修变速箱并据此定价。

description.en: An active downshift/control symptom exists; stop driving, transport the truck, and require Ford-enhanced diagnosis plus assessment of any secondary driveline damage before a buy decision.
description.zh: 车辆存在正在发生的异常降挡/控制症状；停止驾驶并拖运，要求Ford增强诊断及传动系统次生损伤评估后再决定是否购买。

label.en: Recall signal: localized cylinder-head overheating and oil-leak fire risk
label.zh: 召回信号：缸盖局部过热、漏油及起火风险

summary.en: NHTSA campaign 13V583/Ford 13S12 covers certain 2013 Escape vehicles with the 1.6L engine. Localized cylinder-head overheating may crack the head and allow oil leakage onto a hot engine surface.
summary.zh: NHTSA 13V583/Ford 13S12覆盖部分配备1.6L发动机的2013 Escape。缸盖局部过热可能导致缸盖开裂，机油泄漏到高温发动机表面。

symptoms.en: Overheating, coolant-control concerns, oil leakage, oil odor, or evidence of an underhood thermal event.
symptoms.zh: 过热、冷却系统异常、漏油、机油气味或发动机舱过热痕迹。

stranding_or_safety_risk.en: Oil contacting a hot surface can cause an engine-compartment fire; overheating can also lead to loss of mobility. Active overheating, smoke, or oil-on-hot-surface evidence requires stopping the engine.
stranding_or_safety_risk.zh: 机油接触高温表面可能引发发动机舱火灾，过热也可能导致无法行驶。若正在过热、冒烟或发现机油接触高温部件，应立即熄火。

basic_obd_visibility.en: A basic reader may show temperature- or misfire-related powertrain data after a problem develops, but it cannot inspect cracks, shielding, coolant-system modifications, oil leaks, or recall completion.
basic_obd_visibility.zh: 普通OBD可能在问题发生后显示温度或失火相关动力总成数据，但无法检查裂纹、隔热件、冷却系统改造、漏油或召回是否完成。

confirmation_tests.en: Verify campaign 13S12/13V583 by VIN in NHTSA and Ford systems and obtain the dealer remedy record.
confirmation_tests.zh: 使用VIN在NHTSA和Ford系统核验13S12/13V583，并取得经销商召回处理记录。

confirmation_tests.en: Cold-inspect for coolant/oil leaks and thermal damage, then perform a cooling-system pressure test and scan enhanced Ford data before any extended road test.
confirmation_tests.zh: 冷车检查冷却液/机油泄漏及过热损伤，进行冷却系统压力测试并读取Ford增强数据后，再考虑长距离路试。

description.en: VIN is outside the campaign or documented recall work is complete, with no leak or overheating evidence; preserve records and continue the full PPI.
description.zh: VIN不在召回范围或已有完成召回的记录，且无泄漏/过热证据；保存记录并继续完整PPI。

description.en: Recall status is open/unknown but no active symptom exists; arrange Ford recall inspection/remedy and cooling-system verification before purchase.
description.zh: 召回状态未完成/未知但没有当前症状；购车前安排Ford召回检查/处理和冷却系统验证。

description.en: Active overheat, oil leak, smoke, or thermal damage exists; do not drive, transport the vehicle, and require leak-source, cylinder-head, engine, and fire-damage assessment.
description.zh: 存在过热、漏油、冒烟或热损伤；不要驾驶，拖运车辆，并检查泄漏源、缸盖、发动机及火灾损伤。

label.en: Recall signal: front link-shaft bracket fracture
label.zh: 召回信号：前传动半轴支架断裂

summary.en: NHTSA campaign 20V692/Ford 20S63 covers certain FWD Explorers with 2.0L or 2.3L engines. The front drive-axle link-shaft support bracket may fracture after long-term vibration.
summary.zh: NHTSA 20V692/Ford 20S63覆盖部分配备2.0L或2.3L发动机的前驱Explorer。前驱动半轴支撑支架可能因长期振动而断裂。

symptoms.en: Loss of motive power or loss of park holding function; the official filing states failure can occur without warning.
symptoms.zh: 可能失去驱动力或P挡驻车保持功能；官方文件指出可能在无预警情况下失效。

stranding_or_safety_risk.en: Bracket failure can strand the vehicle, permit unintended movement in Park, or cause loss of motive power while driving, increasing crash risk.
stranding_or_safety_risk.zh: 支架失效可能导致车辆抛锚、P挡意外移动或行驶中失去驱动力，从而增加碰撞风险。

basic_obd_visibility.en: This is a mechanical bracket condition. A generic OBD-II scan may remain clear and cannot inspect bracket integrity or prove recall completion.
basic_obd_visibility.zh: 这是机械支架问题。普通OBD-II可能完全无报码，无法检查支架完整性或证明召回已完成。

confirmation_tests.en: Verify campaign 20S63/20V692 by VIN and obtain Ford dealer completion documentation.
confirmation_tests.zh: 使用VIN核验20S63/20V692，并取得Ford经销商完成记录。

confirmation_tests.en: Inspect the link-shaft bracket and driveline on a lift; test Park holding only in a controlled, chocked setting and stop if any loss-of-drive symptom exists.
confirmation_tests.zh: 举升检查传动半轴支架和传动系统；仅在受控且使用车轮挡块的情况下测试P挡保持，若有失去驱动力症状则停止测试。

description.en: VIN is outside the campaign or documented remedy is complete and lift inspection finds no bracket/driveline concern; continue the PPI.
description.zh: VIN不在范围或有已完成召回的记录，且举升检查未见支架/传动异常；继续PPI。

description.en: VIN is open/unknown without active symptoms; arrange the authorized bracket remedy and verify Park/driveline operation before purchase.
description.zh: VIN召回未完成/未知且暂无症状；购车前安排授权支架召回处理并验证P挡和传动功能。

description.en: Loss of drive, roll-away, or bracket damage is present; do not road-test, transport the vehicle, and assess secondary axle/transmission damage before deciding.
description.zh: 出现失去驱动力、溜车或支架损伤；不要路试，拖运车辆，并评估半轴/变速箱次生损伤后再决定。

label.en: Recall signal: reduced vacuum brake assist
label.zh: 召回信号：制动真空助力下降

summary.en: NHTSA campaign 19V645/GM N192268490 covers certain 2014-2018 Silverado vehicles using an affected vacuum-pump design. Pump vacuum can decrease over time and reduce brake assist.
summary.zh: NHTSA 19V645/GM N192268490覆盖部分采用相关真空泵设计的2014-2018 Silverado。真空泵输出可能随时间下降，导致刹车助力降低。

symptoms.en: Hard brake pedal, increased pedal effort, or increased stopping distance, especially at low speed or after repeated brake applications.
symptoms.zh: 刹车踏板变硬、踩踏力度增加或制动距离变长，尤其可能在低速或连续制动后出现。

stranding_or_safety_risk.en: Reduced brake assist increases stopping effort and distance and can cause a crash. An active hard-pedal condition is safety-critical.
stranding_or_safety_risk.zh: 制动助力下降会增加踩踏力度和制动距离，可能导致碰撞；正在发生的硬踏板属于关键安全问题。

basic_obd_visibility.en: A basic emissions-oriented OBD reader usually does not provide full EBCM/brake-module coverage and cannot measure vacuum-pump performance or prove the recall calibration was installed.
basic_obd_visibility.zh: 以排放为主的普通OBD通常不能完整读取EBCM/制动模块，也无法测量真空泵性能或证明召回标定已经安装。

confirmation_tests.en: Verify N192268490/19V645 by VIN in NHTSA and GM systems and obtain dealer campaign-completion evidence.
confirmation_tests.zh: 使用VIN在NHTSA和GM系统核验N192268490/19V645，并取得经销商召回完成证据。

confirmation_tests.en: Perform a controlled brake-assist test, enhanced EBCM scan, vacuum measurement, and full brake inspection; do not use a road test to discover an active hard-pedal condition.
confirmation_tests.zh: 进行受控刹车助力测试、EBCM增强扫描、真空测量和完整制动检查；不要通过上路来试出正在发生的硬踏板问题。

description.en: VIN is outside the campaign or remedy completion is documented, and brake/vacuum tests pass; retain evidence and continue the PPI.
description.zh: VIN不在范围或召回完成已有记录，且刹车/真空测试通过；保存证据并继续PPI。

description.en: Campaign status is open/unknown with no current hard-pedal symptom; arrange the authorized recall calibration and verify brake-assist performance before purchase.
description.zh: 召回未完成/未知且当前无硬踏板症状；购车前安排授权召回标定并验证刹车助力。

description.en: Brake assist is reduced or vacuum/brake faults are active; do not drive, transport the truck, and require pump, booster, hydraulic brake, and EBCM diagnosis before valuation.
description.zh: 刹车助力已下降或真空/制动故障正在发生；不要驾驶，拖运车辆，并检查真空泵、助力器、液压制动和EBCM后再估值。

label.en: Recall signal: windshield-wiper module corrosion and failure
label.zh: 召回信号：雨刮模块腐蚀和失效

summary.en: NHTSA campaign 22V165/GM N212352530 covers certain 2014-2015 Equinox vehicles. Corrosion at wiper-module ball joints may disable one or both windshield wipers.
summary.zh: NHTSA 22V165/GM N212352530覆盖部分2014-2015 Equinox。雨刮模块球头腐蚀可能导致一个或两个前雨刮失效。

symptoms.en: One or both windshield wipers move slowly, bind, park incorrectly, or become inoperative.
symptoms.zh: 一个或两个前雨刮动作缓慢、卡滞、停止位置异常或完全不工作。

stranding_or_safety_risk.en: Inoperative wipers can abruptly remove forward visibility in rain or snow and increase crash risk; do not drive in conditions requiring wipers.
stranding_or_safety_risk.zh: 雨雪天气中雨刮失效会突然失去前方视野并增加碰撞风险；需要使用雨刮时不要驾驶故障车辆。

basic_obd_visibility.en: This mechanical/body-system condition is outside generic emissions OBD coverage. A clear basic scan says nothing about wiper linkage corrosion or recall completion.
basic_obd_visibility.zh: 该机械/车身系统问题不属于普通排放OBD覆盖范围。基础扫描无报码不能说明雨刮连杆是否腐蚀，也不能证明召回已完成。

confirmation_tests.en: Verify N212352530/22V165 by VIN and retain GM dealer remedy documentation.
confirmation_tests.zh: 使用VIN核验N212352530/22V165，并保留GM经销商召回处理记录。

confirmation_tests.en: Function-test all wiper speeds and washer operation, then inspect module/linkage joints for corrosion or binding with the cowl removed as appropriate.
confirmation_tests.zh: 测试全部雨刮速度及喷水功能，并在合适情况下拆开饰板检查模块/连杆球头是否腐蚀或卡滞。

description.en: VIN is outside the campaign or documented remedy is complete, and wiper function/linkage inspection passes; continue inspection.
description.zh: VIN不在范围或召回完成已有记录，且雨刮功能/连杆检查通过；继续检查。

description.en: VIN is open/unknown without a current failure; arrange the authorized module inspection/remedy before relying on the vehicle in rain or snow.
description.zh: VIN召回未完成/未知且目前尚未失效；在雨雪中使用车辆前安排授权模块检查/处理。

description.en: Wipers bind or fail; do not drive in precipitation, transport if needed, and inspect motor, module, linkage, cowl drains, and water-related secondary damage.
description.zh: 雨刮卡滞或失效；降水天气不要驾驶，必要时拖运，并检查电机、模块、连杆、导水槽排水及进水次生损伤。

label.en: Recall signal: crankshaft tone-wheel delamination and engine stall
label.zh: 召回信号：曲轴信号轮分层及发动机熄火

summary.en: NHTSA campaign 20V475/FCA W58 covers certain 2014-2018 Ram 1500 trucks with the 3.0L diesel. Magnetic material can delaminate from the crankshaft tone wheel, disrupting crank-position synchronization and potentially stalling the engine.
summary.zh: NHTSA 20V475/FCA W58覆盖部分配备3.0L柴油发动机的2014-2018 Ram 1500。曲轴信号轮磁性材料可能分层脱落，破坏曲轴位置同步并导致发动机熄火。

symptoms.en: Potential loss of motive power/engine stall; the Part 573 filing states there may be no warning.
symptoms.zh: 可能失去驱动力/发动机熄火；Part 573文件指出可能没有预警。

stranding_or_safety_risk.en: A stall without warning can strand the truck or cause a crash, particularly in traffic. An active stall/no-start history requires transport and diagnosis.
stranding_or_safety_risk.zh: 无预警熄火可能导致抛锚或碰撞，尤其是在车流中。若有正在发生的熄火/无法启动，应拖运并诊断。

basic_obd_visibility.en: A generic reader may catch a powertrain code only if one was stored, but the official filing describes possible failure without warning. No code cannot rule out delamination, campaign applicability, or completion.
basic_obd_visibility.zh: 普通读码器只有在ECU已存储报码时才可能看到动力总成故障，但官方文件说明可能无预警失效。无报码不能排除分层、召回适用性或召回是否完成。

confirmation_tests.en: Verify FCA W58/20V475 by VIN and obtain dated dealer software/remedy completion evidence.
confirmation_tests.zh: 使用VIN核验FCA W58/20V475，并取得带日期的经销商软件/召回完成记录。

confirmation_tests.en: Use FCA-enhanced scan data to review crank/cam synchronization and stall history; investigate any stall/no-start before road testing.
confirmation_tests.zh: 使用FCA增强扫描检查曲轴/凸轮轴同步及熄火历史；任何熄火/无法启动都应先诊断再路试。

description.en: VIN is outside the campaign or documented W58 remedy is complete, with no stall evidence; retain records and continue diesel-specific PPI.
description.zh: VIN不在范围或已有W58完成记录，且无熄火证据；保存记录并继续柴油车专项PPI。

description.en: VIN status is open/unknown without active symptoms; arrange the authorized PCM remedy, confirm calibration, and re-scan before purchase.
description.zh: VIN召回未完成/未知且暂无症状；购车前安排授权PCM处理、确认标定并复扫。

description.en: Stall/no-start or synchronization faults are active; do not drive, transport the truck, and assess tone-wheel/sensor condition plus any secondary engine/fuel-system damage.
description.zh: 正在发生熄火/无法启动或同步故障；不要驾驶，拖运车辆，并检查信号轮/传感器及发动机/燃油系统次生损伤。

label.en: Recall signal: vacuum-pump vane-cap failure and brake-assist loss
label.zh: 召回信号：真空泵叶片端盖失效及制动助力下降

summary.en: NHTSA campaign 21V890/Toyota 21TA09 covers certain non-hybrid 2018-2019 Camry vehicles. A vacuum-pump vane cap can break, stopping vacuum supply to the brake booster.
summary.zh: NHTSA 21V890/Toyota 21TA09覆盖部分非混动2018-2019 Camry。真空泵叶片端盖可能断裂，导致无法向制动助力器提供真空。

symptoms.en: Sudden reduction in power-brake assist and higher brake-pedal effort, potentially after remaining booster vacuum is depleted.
symptoms.zh: 制动助力可能突然下降，助力器剩余真空耗尽后刹车踏板力度会增加。

stranding_or_safety_risk.en: Loss of brake assist increases pedal effort and crash risk. An active hard-pedal complaint is safety-critical and should not be discovered by road testing.
stranding_or_safety_risk.zh: 制动助力丧失会增加踩踏力度和碰撞风险。正在发生的硬踏板属于关键安全问题，不应通过上路试出来。

basic_obd_visibility.en: A generic emissions scan cannot prove mechanical vacuum-pump integrity, full brake-system status, VIN applicability, or recall completion.
basic_obd_visibility.zh: 普通排放OBD无法证明机械真空泵完好、完整制动系统状态、VIN适用性或召回是否完成。

confirmation_tests.en: Verify 21TA09/21V890 by VIN in NHTSA and Toyota systems and obtain dealer completion evidence.
confirmation_tests.zh: 使用VIN在NHTSA和Toyota系统核验21TA09/21V890，并取得经销商完成证据。

confirmation_tests.en: Perform a controlled brake-assist/vacuum test and enhanced brake scan; inspect vacuum-pump condition before road testing.
confirmation_tests.zh: 进行受控制动助力/真空测试和增强制动扫描；路试前检查真空泵状态。

description.en: VIN is outside the campaign or documented remedy is complete and brake-assist testing passes; retain evidence and continue PPI.
description.zh: VIN不在范围或召回完成已有记录，且制动助力测试通过；保存证据并继续PPI。

description.en: VIN status is open/unknown without active symptoms; arrange Toyota recall inspection/remedy and confirm brake-assist operation before purchase.
description.zh: VIN召回未完成/未知且暂无症状；购车前安排Toyota召回检查/处理并确认制动助力。

description.en: Brake assist is reduced or pump damage is suspected; do not drive, transport the car, and inspect pump, booster, vacuum circuit, and hydraulic brakes before valuation.
description.zh: 制动助力下降或怀疑真空泵损坏；不要驾驶，拖运车辆，并检查真空泵、助力器、真空回路和液压制动后再估值。

label.en: Recall signal: CVT torque-converter pump-impeller blade separation
label.zh: 召回信号：CVT液力变矩器泵轮叶片分离

summary.en: NHTSA campaign 18V901/Toyota J17/J07 covers certain 2019 Corolla Hatchbacks with a CVT. Pump-impeller blades in the torque converter may detach under higher-load operation, damage the unit, and cause loss of motive power.
summary.zh: NHTSA 18V901/Toyota J17/J07覆盖部分配备CVT的2019 Corolla Hatchback。高负荷运行时液力变矩器泵轮叶片可能脱落，损坏总成并导致失去驱动力。

symptoms.en: Loss of motive power or vehicle stall, particularly following repeated higher-load acceleration.
symptoms.zh: 可能失去驱动力或车辆熄火，尤其是在反复高负荷加速后。

stranding_or_safety_risk.en: Loss of motive power at speed can strand the vehicle and increase crash risk. An active slip/no-drive/stall symptom requires stopping the test.
stranding_or_safety_risk.zh: 高速时失去驱动力可能导致抛锚并增加碰撞风险。若正在打滑、无驱动力或熄火，应停止测试。

basic_obd_visibility.en: A generic reader may see a powertrain code only after a fault is detected; it cannot inspect impeller blades, identify the affected converter by production data, or prove recall completion.
basic_obd_visibility.zh: 普通读码器只有在ECU检测到故障后才可能出现动力总成报码；它无法检查泵轮叶片、按生产数据识别受影响变矩器或证明召回已完成。

confirmation_tests.en: Verify J17/J07/18V901 by VIN and obtain Toyota dealer documentation showing the campaign disposition and remedy.
confirmation_tests.zh: 使用VIN核验J17/J07/18V901，并取得Toyota经销商关于召回状态和处理结果的记录。

confirmation_tests.en: Use Toyota-enhanced transmission scan data and inspect fluid/debris and drivability only after confirming there is no active loss-of-drive symptom.
confirmation_tests.zh: 使用Toyota增强变速箱数据，并在确认没有正在发生的失去驱动力症状后检查油液/碎屑及行驶表现。

description.en: VIN is outside the campaign or dealer records prove remedy complete, with no CVT symptom; retain records and continue PPI.
description.zh: VIN不在范围或经销商记录证明召回已完成，且无CVT症状；保存记录并继续PPI。

description.en: VIN status is open/unknown without symptoms; arrange the authorized campaign inspection/remedy and verify operation before purchase.
description.zh: VIN召回未完成/未知且暂无症状；购车前安排授权召回检查/处理并验证功能。

description.en: Slip, noise, debris, stall, or loss of drive exists; do not road-test, transport the car, and require Toyota-enhanced diagnosis plus assessment of torque-converter/CVT secondary damage.
description.zh: 存在打滑、异响、碎屑、熄火或失去驱动力；不要路试，拖运车辆，并进行Toyota增强诊断及变矩器/CVT次生损伤评估。

label.en: Recall signal: A25A engine-block porosity and coolant/oil leakage
label.zh: 召回信号：A25A发动机缸体孔隙及冷却液/机油泄漏

summary.en: NHTSA campaign 20V064/Toyota 20TA04 covers certain 2019-2020 RAV4 vehicles with a 2.5L A25A engine. Elevated casting porosity may crack cooling passages, allowing internal or external coolant leakage and possible mechanical engine damage.
summary.zh: NHTSA 20V064/Toyota 20TA04覆盖部分配备2.5L A25A发动机的2019-2020 RAV4。铸件孔隙率偏高可能使冷却水道开裂，引起内部或外部冷却液泄漏，并可能造成发动机机械损伤。

symptoms.en: Coolant loss or leakage, overheating, internal engine damage, oil leakage, possible stall, or signs of a thermal event.
symptoms.zh: 冷却液减少/泄漏、过热、发动机内部损伤、漏油、可能熄火或过热事件痕迹。

stranding_or_safety_risk.en: Coolant loss can overheat and stall a conventional gasoline vehicle; mechanical damage may cause oil leakage and fire risk. Active overheating or leakage is a no-drive condition.
stranding_or_safety_risk.zh: 冷却液流失可能使汽油车型过热并熄火；机械损伤还可能漏油并带来火灾风险。正在过热或泄漏时不得驾驶。

basic_obd_visibility.en: A generic reader may show temperature/misfire data after damage begins, but it cannot inspect casting porosity, pressure-test the cooling system, identify affected engine-block production, or prove recall completion.
basic_obd_visibility.zh: 普通OBD可能在损伤发生后显示温度/失火数据，但无法检查铸件孔隙、进行冷却系统压力测试、识别受影响缸体生产批次或证明召回已完成。

confirmation_tests.en: Verify 20TA04/20V064 by VIN and obtain Toyota dealer inspection/remedy documentation; model year alone is insufficient because only a small production subset was involved.
confirmation_tests.zh: 使用VIN核验20TA04/20V064并取得Toyota经销商检查/处理记录；仅凭年款不够，因为只涉及很小的生产子集。

confirmation_tests.en: Cold-inspect for coolant/oil evidence, pressure-test the cooling system, scan Toyota-enhanced data, and evaluate oil/coolant cross-contamination before road testing.
confirmation_tests.zh: 冷车检查冷却液/机油痕迹，进行冷却系统压力测试，读取Toyota增强数据，并在路试前检查油水混合。

description.en: VIN is outside the campaign or documented Toyota inspection/remedy is complete, with clean pressure/leak checks; retain evidence and continue PPI.
description.zh: VIN不在范围或已有Toyota检查/召回完成记录，且压力/泄漏检查正常；保存证据并继续PPI。

description.en: VIN status is open/unknown but no active leak is found; arrange the authorized campaign inspection and engine-block disposition before purchase.
description.zh: VIN召回未完成/未知但未发现当前泄漏；购车前安排授权召回检查并确认缸体处理结论。

description.en: Coolant/oil leakage, overheat, contamination, or engine damage exists; do not drive, transport the vehicle, and require cooling-system, engine-block, internal-engine, and thermal-damage assessment.
description.zh: 存在冷却液/机油泄漏、过热、油水混合或发动机损伤；不要驾驶，拖运车辆，并检查冷却系统、缸体、发动机内部及热损伤。

label.en: Recall signal: crank-position sensor malfunction and engine stall
label.zh: 召回信号：曲轴位置传感器故障及发动机熄火

summary.en: NHTSA campaign 17V356/Toyota H0H covers certain 2016-2017 Tacoma vehicles with the 2GR-FKS V6. A crankshaft-rotor coating interaction can damage the crank-position sensor and disrupt its output.
summary.zh: NHTSA 17V356/Toyota H0H覆盖部分配备2GR-FKS V6的2016-2017 Tacoma。曲轴转子涂层与传感器相互作用可能损坏曲轴位置传感器并中断信号输出。

symptoms.en: Malfunction indicator light, misfire, or in some cases engine stall under varied conditions.
symptoms.zh: 故障灯点亮、失火，或在某些情况下于不同工况下发动机熄火。

stranding_or_safety_risk.en: An engine stall at higher speed can strand the truck and increase crash risk. Active stall/misfire requires diagnosis before driving.
stranding_or_safety_risk.zh: 高速时发动机熄火可能导致抛锚并增加碰撞风险。正在发生的熄火/失火必须先诊断再驾驶。

basic_obd_visibility.en: A generic reader may show MIL or misfire/crank-signal codes if stored, but absence of codes cannot identify the affected sensor/rotor production combination or prove campaign completion.
basic_obd_visibility.zh: 普通读码器可能在已存储时显示故障灯、失火或曲轴信号报码，但无报码不能识别受影响的传感器/转子生产组合，也不能证明召回已完成。

confirmation_tests.en: Verify Toyota H0H/17V356 by VIN and obtain dated dealer sensor-remedy documentation.
confirmation_tests.zh: 使用VIN核验Toyota H0H/17V356，并取得带日期的经销商传感器召回处理记录。

confirmation_tests.en: Review Toyota-enhanced crank/cam synchronization and misfire data; investigate any MIL, misfire, stall, or no-start before a road test.
confirmation_tests.zh: 查看Toyota增强曲轴/凸轮轴同步和失火数据；任何故障灯、失火、熄火或无法启动都应在路试前诊断。

description.en: VIN is outside the campaign or documented H0H remedy is complete, with no MIL/misfire/stall evidence; retain records and continue PPI.
description.zh: VIN不在范围或已有H0H完成记录，且无故障灯/失火/熄火证据；保存记录并继续PPI。

description.en: VIN status is open/unknown without active symptoms; arrange Toyota campaign inspection/remedy and re-scan before purchase.
description.zh: VIN召回未完成/未知且暂无症状；购车前安排Toyota召回检查/处理并复扫。

description.en: MIL, misfire, stall, or no-start is active; do not drive, transport the truck, and diagnose sensor/rotor signal integrity plus any secondary engine or catalyst damage.
description.zh: 正在发生故障灯、失火、熄火或无法启动；不要驾驶，拖运车辆，并诊断传感器/转子信号完整性及发动机或催化器次生损伤。
